svg.title: Gentrex architecture
svg.desc: An 8-page PDF report with 2 scanned pages. gentrex transcribe reads the text of every page, with OCR for the scanned ones. gentrex select keeps the 3 pages with the result and the clinical features. gentrex extract turns them into one record with the values as printed, such as the gene SCN1A and the disease Dravet syndrome. gentrex normalize adds HGNC, MONDO and HPO IDs and ISO dates. The records then load into SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL, or export as GA4GH Phenopackets, into an OMOP CDM or as HL7 FHIR Bundles.
